title: Cosmic Cat Flutist
description: A black and white line-drawn cat in a patterned robe plays a golden flute while standing in purple grass. In the background, a large blue bomb-like head with multiple eyes, stars, and alien symbols floats against a purple and black cosmic landscape featuring a red ringed planet, green lily pads, white geometric trees, and small human figures.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene with a black and white cat wearing a patterned robe standing in purple grass and playing a golden flute. A large blue bomb-shaped head with multiple eyes, stars, and alien runes floats nearby. Red ringed planet in black sky, purple ground with green lily pads and white geometric trees, small astronaut and human figures, psychedelic blacklight poster aesthetic.
